@copilot Update existing PR #20977 directly on its existing head branch with one narrowly scoped, user-directed revision. In instrumentation/rmi/javaagent/src/test/java/io/opentelemetry/javaagent/instrumentation/rmi/RmiTest.java, remoteInterfaceIdentity, restore the original inline span.hasName conditional and remove the new expectedSpanName local and its if/else. Restore the expression-lambda assertion chain rather than leaving unnecessary block-lambda braces:

```java
span ->
    span.hasName(
            emitPreviewRpcSemconv()
                ? (rpcMethod == null ? "java_rmi" : rpcMethod)
                : "rmi.app.Server/" + methodName)
        .hasKind(SpanKind.SERVER)
        .hasAttributesSatisfyingExactly(
            equalTo(RPC_SYSTEM, emitOldRpcSemconv() ? "java_rmi" : null),
            equalTo(RPC_SYSTEM_NAME, emitPreviewRpcSemconv() ? "java_rmi" : null),
            equalTo(RPC_SERVICE, emitOldRpcSemconv() ? "rmi.app.Server" : null),
            equalTo(RPC_METHOD, emitPreviewRpcSemconv() ? rpcMethod : methodName))
```

The user explicitly decided NOT to add a general hasName exception to the rule. This particular emitPreviewRpcSemconv conditional may remain temporarily because that migration gate is going away shortly. Do not document that temporary exception anywhere: no changes to contributor guidance, review instructions, PR metadata, or code comments explaining it. The intended diff of this revision changes only RmiTest.java and restores this assertion to its original pre-PR shape. Preserve its expected values and all runtime behavior. Leave every other cleanup, all seven approved refinements, and all three guidance files untouched.

Keep the existing head branch, main base, and draft state. Do not create another PR or update other branches. Read applicable repository instructions and run the narrowest relevant spotlessApply before focused existing RMI validation. Report validation limitations in the coding result.
